mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_batch (id, channel, business_date, status, bill_source, matched_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{channel}, #{businessDate}, #{status}, #{billSource}, #{matchedCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), bill_source = VALUES(bill_source), matched_count = VALUES(matched_count), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)

INSERT INTO reconciliation_difference (id, batch_id, difference_type, channel_trade_no, order_no, local_amount, channel_amount) VALUES (#{id}, #{batchId}, #{differenceType}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{orderNo}, #{localAmount}, #{channelAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_id, difference_type, channel_trade_no, order_no, local_amount, channel_amount FROM reconciliation_difference WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY id
